title: All Hell Breaks Lose When DCF Shows Up To Collect Baby From Mom
description:
On January 26th, 2023. Police and DCF showed up to a home to remove a newborn baby. According to reports the mom had removed the baby from the hospital without adequate care provided to the baby & without knowledge of the hospital. Reports also states that "allegations of environmental hazards and threat harm were received by the department" in regards to living conditions for the child. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

Disclaimer: 

The videos on Police Watch are intended solely for informative and educational purposes. They are not meant to encourage or promote any illegal activities or unsafe behavior.  Body-worn camera footage has been edited for length and in accordance with YouTube community guidelines while maintaining a journalistic focus. The content is designed to provide insight into law enforcement procedures, police interactions, and public safety awareness. Always respect the law and follow local regulations.
